blocks.text: Sleep Theory returns with “Giving In”, their first original music since their acclaimed 2025 debut, ‘Afterglow’. Fans can stream the song here and watch the music video here. Confronting the relentless cycle of addiction, “Giving In” is accompanied by a haunting music video that traps vocalist Cullen Moore in an endless loop of digging his own grave. Throughout, Moore attacks and buries a version of himself he can’t face, only to claw his way out of the dirt again. Dark figures close in, dragging him back toward his vice, as a sea of dug-up graves reveals he’s ready to start again. Their […]...
